name: Koboshi Renko
source:
She’s the right hand man of the school president ([url=/c703]Kanaka[/url]), she met Kanaka when she had finished her entrance exams and they had been good friends ever since. Renko is very loyal to her friends and she is also very athletic and quick-witted (a deadly combination!).

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/31/preview-diamic-days/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
